name: Black Bean & Bell Pepper Fajitas with Guacamole
instructions: Wash and dry bell peppers. Seed, slice into thin strips, and transfer to a bowl.
Peel, thinly slice into half rings, and add onion to bowl with peppers. Peel and mince garlic; add ½ to bowl with vegetables and place the other ½ into a medium bowl for preparing guacamole.
Halve avocado and remove pit; scoop out the flesh into bowl with garlic.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Wash and dry cilantro. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add ½ to bowl with avocado and save the rest for garnishing.
Add lime juice, salt, and pepper to avocado. Mash with a fork until smooth. Set aside.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add peppers, onion, and garlic from bowl. Stirring frequently, cook until peppers are tender-crisp, 4-5 minutes.
Warm tortillas in another skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Add beans to skillet with vegetables. Season with chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine and cook until beans are heated through, 1-2 minutes.
Place tortillas on a plate and top with fajita filling. Garnish with guacamole, remaining cilantro, and lime wedges. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
